description: Fetch the typed platform-inspection report for a mission, by its issue id. Returns per-section KV/D1/R2 state: task state, retry reason, dispatch error, latest review + QA verdicts, run index, per-attempt provenance, running sandboxes, and session-log heads. Requires the inspect:read scope.

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-199 or WEB-42

orgSlug.description: Narrow an ambiguous issue code to one org

projectId.description: Scope to a specific project id

name: inspect_mission
title: Inspect mission
